instruction: Change the trash folder name for the email account "anonym-x2024@outlook.com" from "Deleted" to "Trash".

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the trash folder name from 'Deleted' to 'Trash' for the email account 'anonym-x2024@outlook.com'. The evaluator first identifies which server ID corresponds to the specified email account by parsing mail.server.serverN.userName and mail.identity.idN.useremail preferences, then checks the trash_folder_name for that specific server. This ensures correct verification even in multi-account Thunderbird setups.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires - trash folder name changed to 'Trash' for account 'anonym-x2024@outlook.com'
Correct account identification logic: Metric parses mail.server.serverN.userName preferences to find the server ID associated with the target email
Fallback mechanism: Includes fallback to check mail.identity.idN.useremail if server userName is not found
Correct state verification: After identifying the server, checks mail.server.{server_id}.trash_folder_name preference
Proper expected parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('trash_folder_name') directly (correct for type='rule')
Correct expected value: 'Trash' semantically matches the instruction requirement
Handles multi-account scenarios: Doesn't hardcode server IDs, dynamically determines the correct server
Correct prefs.js parsing: Properly splits lines by quotes to extract preference keys and values
